problem: Context retrieval for LLM-powered code generation in specialized enterprise environments like ServiceNow, specifically addressing the challenge of predicting required APIs (Script Includes) from partial developer code without explicit queries (p.1).
methodology: The proposed DeepCodeSeek method uses a multi-stage retrieval pipeline comprising a platform metadata Knowledge Graph for search space reduction, an enriched structured index using JSDoc summaries, runtime LLM-powered code expansion for query enhancement, and a reranking stage (p.2, p.3). To enable real-time predictions, a comprehensive post-training pipeline is developed to optimize a compact 0.6B reranker through synthetic dataset generation, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a GRPO-based reinforcement learning (RL) approach (p.1, p.7).
dataset: A custom evaluation dataset consisting of 850 code completion scenarios built from real-world ServiceNow Script Includes, of which 705 clear-intent samples are used for primary evaluation (p.3, p.4). Additionally, a synthetic training dataset of 204 hard-negative-mined samples and an SFT dataset using subsets of the CodeR-Pile dataset are constructed (p.6).
results: The hypothetical code generation method achieves 87.86% top-40 retrieval accuracy on the clear-intent evaluation subset, more than doubling the BM25 baseline of 53.02% (p.5). The optimized 0.6B reranker trained with SFT + RL achieves 68.58% top-5 accuracy, outperforming the larger 8B model baseline at 66.10% while maintaining 2.5x reduced latency (p.7, p.8).
key_findings: Knowledge graph filtering reduces the search space by approximately 59% (p.8, p.12), and JSDoc-based indexing consistently outperforms raw code descriptions in retrieval accuracy (p.4, p.13). The 0.6B reranker optimized with SFT and RL successfully bridges the performance gap to surpass a much larger 8B model while maintaining reduced latency (p.1, p.7).
limitations: The dataset's focus on Script Includes limits generalization to other code completion contexts, synthetic data generation may not fully capture real-world complexity, and the small synthetic dataset size of 204 samples constrains training experiments (p.8).
title: DeepCodeSeek: Real-Time API Retrieval for Context-Aware Code Generation
